500570.name: Tata Motors Limited
examples: Aarogya (Health): child malnutrition programs, preventive/curative healthcare, health awareness for women, drinking water projects, strengthening health institutions
Vidyadhanam (Education): scholarships, remedial coaching, exam preparation support, school infrastructure development
Kaushalya (Employability/Skilling): skill development with ITIs in auto-mechanics, retail, hospitality, driver training
Learn and Earn programme enabled a Melghat tribal region woman to join JLR Slovakia facility after skilling on Harrier-Safari line
500570.notes: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Limited), Annexure-2 Board's Report FY26; Total amount spent for FY = ₹76.95 crore (₹76 cr projects + ₹1 cr admin overheads), Amount Unspent: Nil; excess spent ₹2 crore over 2% obligation of ₹75 crore.

SBIN.name: State Bank of India
examples: Upgraded infrastructure of 699 primary schools (₹24.45 crore) and 453 Primary Health Centres (₹7.01 crore) across India
CSR donation of ₹99.75 lakh for an Alcon Constellation Retina Surgery Machine to Midnapur Rotary Eye Hospital, West Bengal
CSR support of ₹176.49 lakh to Zilla Parishad Girls High School, Alapadu, Dist. Eluru (AP) for infrastructure upgrades including a science lab
CSR donation of ₹86.26 lakh for medical equipment at Bagchi Sri Shankara Cancer Centre & Research Institute, Bhubaneswar (Odisha)
SBIN.notes: Notes to accounts/Statutory Reports, pages 137-142 & 21; Total CSR Expenditure ₹709.01 crore for FY 2025-26 explicitly stated; no separate 2% statutory obligation, unspent, or gross obligation figures disclosed in excerpt (bank donates 1% of prior year profit per RBI guidelines, not standard Sec 135 2% formula figures shown).

RELIANCE.name: Reliance Industries Limited
examples: Reliance Foundation Scholarships supporting 5,100 students annually, mostly meritorious undergraduates from underprivileged backgrounds
Rural Transformation Program promoting climate-resilient agriculture, dairy, goatery, fisheries and non-farm livelihoods for rural communities
Digital Farm School (DFS) providing farmer-centric agricultural extension via digital and on-ground support
Women's empowerment initiative on digital literacy and financial inclusion
RELIANCE.notes: Annexure III, Annual Report on CSR Activities FY2025-26 (Board's Report); amounts as stated in ₹ crore, no conversion needed.

HDFCBANK.name: HDFC Bank Limited
examples: Provided 4 Traveller ambulances to government hospitals in Kangra and Hamirpur districts, Himachal Pradesh
Education projects including school infrastructure improvements, scholarships for meritorious students, and teacher training programmes
Health and Hygiene projects assessing impact of health facility upgrades, drinking water systems, and sanitation infrastructure
Provided an Electric Vehicle garbage collection truck to Greater Chennai Municipal Corporation
HDFCBANK.notes: Annexure 2 to Directors' Report (Annual Report on CSR Activities), FY2025-26; amounts already in INR crore as stated in report (Total Amount Spent for FY = INR 1,316.18 Cr per item 6(d)/6(e); Total CSR obligation = INR 1,312.96 Cr per item 5(e); 2% requirement = INR 1,312.64 Cr per item 5(b)). Note 33 to standalone financials shows slightly different 'Amount of expenditure incurred' of INR 1,315.87 Cr (cash basis) vs Annexure's 1,316.18 Cr (accrual, incl. impact assessment).

LICI.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
examples: LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation sanctioned 119 projects worth ₹77.74 crore in FY26, with health-related projects receiving the highest-ever allocation of ₹62.20 crore
Provided 10,660 new scholarships to meritorious students from underprivileged families in FY26
Since inception, 437 projects sanctioned for healthcare and 417 for education, out of 1045 total projects worth ₹303 crore (as on 31.03.2026)
Runs rural education programs, vocational and skill development initiatives, and healthcare/medical support activities
LICI.notes: CSR under Section 135 NOT applicable to LIC (statutory corporation under LIC Act 1956, outside Companies Act 2013 CSR purview). Voluntary social spend done via LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation (Charitable Trust); figures given are Foundation project sanctions, not a Section 135 CSR spend table, so csr_spent/obligation/2%/unspent are null (not applicable/not disclosed in that format).

ICICIBANK.name: ICICI Bank Limited
examples: Provided Dual Energy CT Simulator (DECT) at ACTREC's Proton Therapy Centre, Navi Mumbai, benefiting 1,265 cancer patients
Provided robotic gait training machine to Bhagwan Mahaveer Viklang Sahayata Samiti, Jaipur for patients with paralysis-related mobility issues
Supported surgical equipment at Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Punjab
Financial literacy training programme reaching over 0.69 million individuals across India
ICICIBANK.notes: Note 55 to Standalone Accounts & Board's Report Annexure (Sec 135); figures converted from ₹ million to ₹ crore (÷100). CSR obligation ₹9,940.6mn=₹994.06cr; 2% req per Board Report ₹9,922.3mn=₹992.23cr; amount spent (excl. unspent A/c utilisation) ₹8,780.5mn=₹878.05cr; shortfall/unspent transferred ₹1,161.0mn=₹116.10cr (used as unspent).
